page_title: HOL 1-6 BAY | Holstein Kiel v Bayern Munich 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+1' 1 - 6 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) calmly steps up and places the ball into the bottom left corner.
90+1' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The Bayern Munich players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

90' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bayern Munich players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Tobias Reichel interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
89' Dirk Bremser appears to have said too much and referee Tobias Reichel comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
88' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
86' OFF THE WOODWORK! Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
83' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' 1 - 5 Goal! Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) makes the score 1:5 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Tymoteusz Puchacz.
81' Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) sees a yellow card from Tobias Reichel after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
79' Neat passing move from Bayern Munich in order to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) is brought on as a substitute for Lewis Holtby.
76' Dirk Bremser decides to make a substitution. Finn Porath will be replaced by Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel).
76' The substitution has been made. Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) has replaced Kingsley Coman.
75' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
75' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Timon Weiner comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Holstein Kiel take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Holstein Kiel, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
69' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
68' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
68' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
65' 0 - 5 Goal! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:5.

65' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch for Sacha Boey.
64' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Raphael Guerreiro and he is replaced by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Shuto Machino as he is replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
63' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
63' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
62' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
60' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
59' The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
59' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends the corner into the box, but Timon Weiner intercepts it and averts the threat.
58' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich).
56' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

56' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
55' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
52' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Timon Weiner was alert and made a comfortable save.
52' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle. Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) commits a foul after dangerous play.
51' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
50' Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
49' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) brings his opponent down. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
46' The game is over for Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich). Michael Olise comes on for the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Vincent Kompany gives a chance to Thomas Muller and Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Dirk Bremser decided to make a change. Patrick Erras (Holstein Kiel) is replaced by Max Geschwill.
46' Dirk Bremser makes a switch. Tymoteusz Puchacz is coming on in place of Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Tobias Reichel has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) produces a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Timon Weiner thwarts him and the score remains the same. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.

43' 0 - 4 Kingsley Coman produces a killer pass to release Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who then unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 0:4!
39' Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
38' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) picks up the rebound and shoots. The goalkeeper was ready and denies his effort with a fine save.
37' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Timon Weiner.
36' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
36' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) takes the corner with a short pass.

35' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Holstein Kiel have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
33' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
32' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
29' The free kick is taken by Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel), but ball is cleared.

28' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Holstein Kiel are awarded the free kick.
26' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds free space in the penalty box and sends in a first-time shot. It's a poor effort which goes miles wide of the left post.
26' The corner kick falls to Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich), who does his best to finish. The snap shot, however, only marks the left post!
25' The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
24' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
19' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Reichel blows for a foul.
14' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
13' 0 - 3 This is definitely not what Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 0:3.
10' Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
9' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.
9' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
7' 0 - 2 GOAL! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:2.
5' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

1' 0 - 1 It's in! Harry Kane spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. The score is now 0:1.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Tobias Reichel will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
